turns.input: Mira Thorne gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Mira Thorne reaches into one of her many pockets and produces a worn pair of leather boots, extending them toward Nicco with a slight, assessing tilt of her head. "Found these in my back room—wrong size, wrong everything, been sitting there since before I took the place over." She gives a small shrug, plant-stained fingers tapping the worn sole once. "Better someone walks in them than they keep gathering dust."

She hands the pair of leather boots to Nicco, and he takes them.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
"Thanks," he said, after which he decided to give them back the boots. "You'll need them more than me."

Nicco offered the leather boots to Mira Thorne.

Mira Thorne simply looked at the proffered boots for a moment, her expression unreadable. She did not reach for them. "I've already got a pair that fit," she said, her tone neutral, matter-of-fact. "Those didn't. That's why they were sitting in my back room." She made no move to accept the return, leaving the boots with Nicco.
